slice-a-registry-mode-model-author-glm-a.text: Twenty-six tasks: definitions first, the statements over reachable states, the open application before naming, the refused reads, the deposit and its custody census, naming's six-edge policy, the retirement map, the observation surface the frozen oracle reads, the regenerated corpora and pages, and the four mutants with their controls.

slice-b-163-simulator-author-muse-audito.text: Nine tasks, starting only after the model slice's audit passes: the profiles, the named refusals, replay agreement, the journeys and their limits, the clarity record, the counts, the browser checks and fresh speech.

gate-held-not-a-task.text: The gate criteria are not checkboxes. Only the ticket gate, on the combined tree, may claim the repository green.

forward-repair-after-merge.text: One forward repair task keeps the registry rename rewrite extent aligned with its residual gate for Lean and HTML files, with controls in both directions.
